title: AiSensei Phase 0 scenario definitions
description: Non-prescriptive acceptance scenarios. Fixture numbers, where introduced later, must be demoOnly.

scenarios.given: The runner has not supplied recent longest-session information.
Only a demoOnly or draft candidate template is available.
then: Any development preview is visibly demo-only.

scenarios.given: A fixed date cannot satisfy the reviewed template duration or protected taper.
then: Do not silently compress the plan or taper.

scenarios.given: No allowed weekly pattern fits the selected days, minute limits, and reviewed recovery spacing.
One ordinary session is explicitly marked missed.
then: Offer a move only if all reviewed constraints pass.

scenarios.given: A long session is explicitly missed.
scenarios.when: The next long session is assessed.
then: Do not treat the missed session as completed.

scenarios.given: A reviewed concern flag is logged.
then: Do not diagnose or clear the runner.

scenarios.given: A log or availability change occurs after a proposal was previewed.
scenarios.when: The runner applies the old proposal.
